**2024 Taiwanese Presidential Election – Nominees (Candidates) and Their Birth Dates**

| Candidate (English name) | Chinese name | Political Party | Date of Birth |
|--------------------------|--------------|-----------------|---------------|
| **Lai Ching‑te** (William Lai) | 蔡英文 (Lai Ching‑te) | Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) | **6 October 1959** |
| **Hou Yu‑ih** | 郝雨希 | Kuomintang (KMT) | **7 June 1957** |
| **Ko Wen‑je** | 柯文哲 | Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) | **6 August 1959** |

### Brief notes
* **Lai Ching‑te** (also known internationally as William Lai) was the former Premier of Taiwan and the DPP’s presidential nominee.
* **Hou Yu‑ih** is a former police chief and the KMT’s presidential nominee.
* **Ko Wen‑je**, the incumbent mayor of Taipei, ran as the candidate of the newly‑formed Taiwan People’s Party.

These three candidates were the officially registered nominees for the presidential election held on **13 January 2024**. (No other parties or independents achieved the required registration threshold to appear on the ballot.)
